$comment: Presets for the Mini Particle Simulator.
Two MSYS2 toolchains (UCRT64 GCC, CLANG64 Clang), each with Debug and Release.
or:  cmake --workflow --preset clang-debug   (configure + build in one go)

configurePresets.name: base
$comment: Hidden common base. Never invoked directly, only inherited from.
Ninja: a single-config generator, so each concrete preset sets its own CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE.
binaryDir keys on ${presetName} so every toolchain/config gets an isolated build tree
CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON writes compile_commands.json so clangd/IDEs can resolve
includes (this is what clears the 'glm/glm.hpp file not found' editor noise).

configurePresets.name: gcc
$comment: Hidden UCRT64 GCC toolchain. Explicit compiler paths mean no manual -D flags are needed.
environment.PATH prepends C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin for two reasons (see PROGRESS-GPU Session 14):
1. windres needs its companion GCC preprocessor on PATH at configure time.
2. the built .exe needs libstdc++/libgcc DLLs on PATH at run time.
Build and test presets inherit this environment automatically

configurePresets.name: clang
$comment: Hidden CLANG64 toolchain. PROGRESS-GPU notes this is the preferred, faster build.
llvm-windres is the RC compiler; clang64/bin goes on PATH for the same windres + runtime-DLL
reasons as the GCC toolchain above.

configurePresets.name: gcc-debug
configurePresets.description: UCRT64 GCC, -O0 -Wall -Wextra, Vulkan debug layer on.
configurePresets.$comment: CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug is what drives the $<CONFIG:Debug> generator expressions in CMakeLists (the -O0/warning flags and the ENABLE_DEBUG_LAYER define).

workflowPresets.name: clang-debug
workflowPresets.$comment: One-shot configure -> build for the Clang Debug config: cmake --workflow --preset clang-debug
